mainEntity.name: What are Mixture of Scars (MoS) and Associative SCache O(1)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mixture of Scars (MoS) streams 80 layers of a 72.7B LLM in <= 2.40 GB peak VRAM via directional VQ4/INT4 bases plus low-rank residual scars, while SCache O(1) replaces linear O(T) KV Cache with constant-byte Widrow-Hoff associative memory (34.8 KB L1, Δ = +0 B).

mainEntity.name: How does ScarNativeLM v5.0 eliminate post-training quantization shock?

acceptedAnswer.text: ScarNativeLM v5.0 is pretrained 100% from scratch (step t = 0, zero nn.Linear layers) with ScarNativeLinear (D4-LUT256 VQ4-STE + FWHT-64 + INT4-STE) and DifferentiableSCacheAttention O(1), yielding 0.000000 KL divergence upon binary packing.

mainEntity.name: How does PointScarFlow v1.0 generate continuous 3D point clouds in WebGPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: PointScarFlow v1.0 (11.85M ScarNativeLinear parameters in a 3.87 MiB shard, 12 WGSL shaders) integrates an Optimal-Transport Rectified Flow velocity field for 1,024 3D points in 86.45 ms directly from Qwen2.5-3B Layer 23 P_perp_lang latents with > 0.997 cross-lingual shape cosine.
